fullwidth glyphs from Chinese, Japanese or Korean languages), the user
should install `wcwidth` library. To install it together with
`tabulate`:

```shell
pip install tabulate[widechars]
```

already installed. To disable wide characters support without
uninstalling `wcwidth`, set the global module-level flag

def test_plain_maxcolwidth_autowraps():
    "Output: maxcolwidth will result in autowrapping longer cells"
    table = [["hdr", "fold"], ["1", "very long data"]]
    expected = "\n".join(["  hdr  fold", "    1  very long", "       data"])
    result = tabulate(table, headers="firstrow", tablefmt="plain", maxcolwidths=[10, 10])
    assert_equal(expected, result)
